newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Beaconsfield, Allstate results in line.
newsitem.headline: Beaconsfield, Allstate results in line.

text.p: Beaconsfield Gold NL said on Monday further drilling results from its gold joint venture in Tasmania were generally in line with expectations.
The exception was hole C28 in the Western Domain of the Tasmania Reef Resource, which returned 19.55 grammes per tonne (g/t) over an estimated width of 6.42 metres, the company said.

Other results included 51.56 g/t from an estimated width of 6.02 metres from hole C32 in the Central Domain and 8.21 g/t over an estimated width of 4.65 metres in hole C35, also in the Central Domain.
Allstate Explorations NL is manager of the mine and holds 62.18 percent while Beaconsfield holds 37.82 percent.
However, 22 percent of Allstate's stake, which was previously the Ashanti Goldfields' stake, remains subject to pre-emption discussions between the two joint venturers venturers.
By 11.55 a.m (0155 GMT), Beaconsfield shares were unchanged at A$1.21 after just one trade of 13,000 shares. Allstate shares were untraded but bid 18 cents lower at A$1.72.
